purpose: Exclusively reserve People main migration V58 and its exact path for the BASE-TFR-HRM-009 request/issue metadata Stage A without activating migration authoring. A later append-only successor may activate the lease only after actual clean pinned backend worktree materialization is evidenced; executable source authority additionally requires the matching owner packet and an executable successor token.

lease.reservationSemantics: This document reserves only the version and exact path. It is not an active lease and grants no migration write, source write, test, commit or push authority. Actual clean pinned backend worktree evidence must be hash-bound by a later active-lease successor, and that successor must then be bound by a separate executable source token.

createTables.name: ppl_certificate_requests
columns: public_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid()
requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
constraints: fk_ppl_certificate_requests_requester FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, requester_person_id) REFERENCES ppl_persons(tenant_id, person_id)
fk_ppl_certificate_requests_subject FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, subject_person_id) REFERENCES ppl_persons(tenant_id, person_id)
ck_ppl_certificate_requests_state lifecycle_state IN REQUESTED, VALIDATING, ISSUED, FAILED, CANCELLED

createTables.name: ppl_issued_certificates
columns: public_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid()
legal_hold BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
constraints: fk_ppl_issued_certificates_request FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, certificate_request_id) REFERENCES ppl_certificate_requests(tenant_id, certificate_request_id)
ck_ppl_issued_certificates_state lifecycle_state IN ISSUED, REVOKED, EXPIRED
ck_ppl_issued_certificates_expiry expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > issued_at
ck_ppl_issued_certificates_revoke requires revoked_at and revoke_reason_code when state is REVOKED

indexes.name: uidx_ppl_command_receipts_tenant_command_idempotency
indexes.precondition: Fail the migration if duplicate rows exist; do not delete, merge or rewrite receipts.

guardFunctionsAndTriggers.events: BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE
rules: allow insert only with lifecycle_state REQUESTED and version 0
allow only REQUESTED to VALIDATING or CANCELLED and VALIDATING to ISSUED or FAILED
deny changes to tenant, public ID, requester, subject, type, locale, purpose, template identity/version, correlation, requested_at and created_by
require version to advance exactly by one for an allowed transition
require completed_at for ISSUED, FAILED and CANCELLED

guardFunctionsAndTriggers.events: BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE
rules: allow insert only with lifecycle_state ISSUED and a same-tenant parent request in VALIDATING
allow only ISSUED to EXPIRED or ISSUED to REVOKED before expiry
deny changes to tenant, public ID, request ID, object identity/version, content digest, verification-token hash, issued_at and created_by
require revoke timestamp and reason for REVOKED
deny any transition out of REVOKED or EXPIRED

new command-receipt, audit or outbox table
data backfill, deletion or automatic privilege elevation

The planned backend worktree path or branch exists with a different head, tree, upstream or non-empty porcelain.
An existing migration must change, a second People migration is required or a data backfill becomes necessary.
Any table, index, policy or guard outside the exact manifest is required.
